sections.name: pallavi
lines: endarO mahAnubhAvu-landariki vandanamu

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: canduru varNuni anda candamunu hrdayAra-
vindamuna jUci brahmAnandamanu bhavincu vAr-

sections.name: caraNam 1
lines: sAma gAna lOla manasija lAvaNya dhanya mUrdhanyul

sections.name: caraNam 2
lines: mAnasa vana cara vara sancAramu salipi mUrti bAguga pogaDanE vAr-

sections.name: caraNam 3
lines: saraguna pAdamulaku svAntamanu sarOjamunu samarpaNamu sEyu vAr-

sections.name: caraNam 4
lines: patita pAvanuDanE parAtparuni gurinci paramArthamagu nija mArgamutOnu
bADucunu sallApamutO svara layAdi rAgamula deliyu vAr-

sections.name: caraNam 5
lines: hari guNa maNimaya saramulu galamuna shObhillu bhakta kOTulilalO telivitO
celimitO karuNa galgu jagamellanu sudhA drSTicE brOcu vAr-

sections.name: caraNam 6
lines: hoyalu mIra naDalu galgu sarasuni sadA kanula jucucunu pulaka
sharIrula I Ananda payOdhi nimagnula I mudambunanu yashamu galavAr-

sections.name: caraNam 7
lines: parama bhAgavata mauni vara shashi vibhAkara sanaka sanandana
digIsha sura kimpuruSa kanaka kashipu suta nArada tumburu
pavanasUnu bAlacandra dhara shuka sarOjabhava bhUsuravarulu
parama pAvanulu ghanulu shAshvatulu kamala bhava sukhamu sadAnubhavulu gAka

sections.name: caraNam 8
lines: nI mEnu nAma vaibhavambulanu nI parAkrama dhairyamula shAnta mAnasamu nIvulanu
vacana satyamunu raghuvara nIyeDa sadbhaktiyu janincakanu durmatamulanu kalla
jEsinaTTi nImadi neringi santasambunanu guNa bhajanA-nanda kirtanamu jEyu vAr-

sections.name: caraNam 9
lines: bhAgavata rAmAyaNa gItAdi shruti shAstra purAnamu marmamulanu shivAdi sanmatamula
gUDhamulan muppadi mukkOTi surAntarangamula bhAvamula nerigi bhava rAga layAdi
saukhyamucE cirAyuvula galigi niravadhi sukhAtmulai tyAgarAptulaina vAr-

sections.name: caraNam 10
lines: prEma muppiri gonu vELa nAmamu dalacEvAru rAmabhaktuDaina tyAgarAjanutuni nija dAsulaina vAr-

sections.name: pallavi
lines: jagadAnanda kAraka jaya jAnaki prANa nAyaka

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: gaganAdhipa satkulaja rAja rAjEshvara suguNAkara surasEvya bhavya dAyaka sadA sakala

sections.name: caraNam 1
lines: amara tAraka nicaya kumuda hita paripUrNA naga sura surabhUja
dadhi payOdhi vAsa haraNa sundaratara vadana sudhAmaya vacO
brnda gOvinda sAnanda mA varAjarApta shubhakar A nEka

sections.name: caraNam 2
lines: nigama nirajAmrutaja pOSakA nimiSavairi vArida samIraNa
khaga turanga satkavi hrdAlayA gaNita vAnarAdhipa natAnghri yuga

sections.name: caraNam 3
lines: indra nIlamaNi sannibhApa ghana candra sUrya nayanApramEya vA-
gIndra janaka sakalEsha subhra nAgEndra shayana shamana vairi sannuta

sections.name: caraNam 4
lines: pAda vijita mauni shApa sava paripAla vara mantra grahaNa lOla
parama shAnta citta janakajAdhipa sarOjabhava varadAkhila

sections.name: caraNam 5
lines: shrSTi sthityantakAra kAmita kAmita phaladA samAna gAtra sha-
cIpati nutAbdhi mada harAnurA garAga rAjita kathA sArahita

sections.name: caraNam 6
lines: sajjana mAnasAbdhi sudhAkara kusuma vimAna surasAripu karAbja
lAlita caranAva guNA suragaNa mada haraNa sanAtanA januta

sections.name: caraNam 7
lines: OmkAra panjara kIra pura hara sarOja bhava kEshavAdi rUpa vAsavaripu janakAntaka kalA
dharApta karuNAkara sharaNAgata janapAlana sumanO ramaNa nirvikAra nigama sAratara

sections.name: caraNam 8
lines: karadhrta sharajAlA sura madApa haraNa vanIsura surAvana
kavIna bilaja mauni krta caritra sannuta shrI tyAgarAjanuta

sections.name: caraNam 9
lines: purANa puruSa nrvarAtmajA shrita parAdhIna kara virAdha rAvaNa
virAvaNA nagha parAshara manOharA vikrta tyAgarAja sannuta

sections.name: caraNam 10
lines: agaNita guNa kanaka cEla sAla viDalanAruNAbha samAna caraNApAra
mahimAdbhuta su-kavijana hrtsadana sura munigaNa vihita kalasha nIra
nidhijA ramaNa pApa gaja nrsimha vara tyAgarAjAdhinuta

sections.name: pallavi
lines: duDuku gala nannE dora koDuku brOcurA entO

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: kaDu durviSayA krSTuDai-gaDiya gaDiyaku ninDAru

sections.name: caraNam 1
lines: shrI vanitA hrtkumudAbjA vAngmAnasa gOcara

sections.name: caraNam 2
lines: sakala bhUtamula andu nI vaiyuNDaga madilEka pOyina

sections.name: caraNam 3
lines: ciruta prAyamu nADe bhajanAmrta rasavihIna kutarkuDaina

sections.name: caraNam 4
lines: para dhanamula koraku nOrula madini karaga-baliki kaDupu nimpa diriginaTTi

sections.name: caraNam 5
lines: tanamadini bhuvini saukhyapu jIvanamE anucu sadA dinamulu gaDipE

sections.name: caraNam 6
lines: telayani naTaviTa kSUdrulu vanitalu sva vashamautakupadEshinci santasilli
svaralayambu lerungakanushIlAtmuDai su-bhaktulaku samanamanu

sections.name: caraNam 7
lines: druSTiki sArambagu lalanA sadanArbhaka sEnAmita dhanAdulanu dEvadi dEva
nera nammitini gAkanI padAbja bhajanambu maracina

sections.name: caraNam 8
lines: cakkani mukha kamalambunu sadA nA midilO smaraNa lEkanE durmadAndha-
janula kOri paritApamulacE dagili nogili durvisaya durAsalanu rOyalEka
satata maparAdhinai capala cittuDanaina

sections.name: caraNam 9
lines: mAnavatanu durlabha manucu nEnci paramAnanda mondaleka mada matsara
kAma lObha mOhamulaku dAsuDai mOsabOti gAka modaTi kulajuDagucu bhuvini
shUdula panulu salpucunu uNTinigAka nArAdamulu kOri sArahIna matamulanu sAdhimpa dArumAru

sections.name: caraNam 10
lines: satulakai konnALLAstikai sutulakai konnALLu dhana tatulakai tirigiti nayya tyAgarAjApta ituvaNTi

sections.name: pallavi
lines: sAdhincenE O manasA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: bOdhincina sanmArga vacanamula bonku jEsi tA baTTina paTTu

sections.name: caraNam
lines: samayAniki dagu mATa lADanE

sections.name: caraNam 1
lines: dEvaki vasudEvula negincinaTu

sections.name: caraNam 2
lines: rangEshuDu sadgangA janakuDu sangIta sAmpradAyakuDu

sections.name: caraNam 3
lines: gOpi jana manOratha mosanga lEkanE geliyu jEsE vADu

sections.name: caraNam 4
lines: vanitala sadA sokka jEyucunu mrokka jEsE paramAtmu-Dadiyu gAka
yashOda tanayuDancu mudambunanu muddu beTTa navvucuNDu hari

sections.name: caraNam 5
lines: parama bhakta vatsaluDu suguNa pArAvaruNDa janma mana ghUDi kali
bAdhalu dIrcu vADanucu nE hrdambujamuna jUcu cuNDaga

sections.name: caraNam 6
lines: harE rAmachandra raghukulEsha mrdu subhASa shESa shayana
para nAri sOdara aja virAjaturaga rAjarAjanuta nirAmaya pAghana
sarasIruha daLAkSa anucu vEDukonna nannu tA brOvakanu

sections.name: caraNam 7
lines: shrI venkaTEsha suprakAsha sarvAnnata sajjana mAnasa nikEtana
kanakAmbara dhara lasan-makuTa kuNDala virAjita harE anucu
nE pogaDaga tyAgarAja gEyuDu mAnavEndraDaina rAmacandruDu

sections.name: caraNam 8
lines: sadbhaktula naData liTla nenE amarikagA nA pUja konenE
aluga vaddananE vimukhulatO jEra bOku mananE veta galigina
tALukommananE damashamAdi sukha dAyakuDagu shrI
tyAgarAja nutuDu centa rAkanE

sections.name: pallavi
lines: kana kana rucirA kanaka vasana ninnu

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: dina dinamuna manasuna canuvuna ninnu (kana)

sections.name: caraNam 1
lines: pAlugAru mOmuna shrIyapAra mahima danaru ninnu (kana)

sections.name: caraNam 2
lines: kalakalamanu mukhakala galigina sIta kulukucu nOra kannulanu jUcE ninnu

sections.name: caraNam 3
lines: bAlArkAbha sucEla maNimaya mAlAlankrta kandhara
sarasijAksa varakapOla surucira kirITadhara santatambu manasAraga

sections.name: caraNam 4
lines: sapatni mAtayau surucicE karNa shUlamaina mATa vInula
jurukkana tALaka shrI harini dhyAninci sukhimpaga lEdA adu

sections.name: caraNam 5
lines: mrdamada lalAma shubhaniTala vara jaTAyu mOkSa phalada pavamAna
sutuDu nIdu mahima delpa sIta delisi valaci sokkalEdA ArAti ninnu

sections.name: caraNam 6
lines: sukhAspada vimukhAmbudhara pavana vidEha mAnasa vihArApta
surabhUja manita guNAnka cidAnanda! khaga turanga dhrta rathAnga
parama dayAkara karuNArasa varuNAlaya bhayApaharA shrI raghupatE

sections.name: caraNam 7
lines: kAminci prEmamIra karamula nIdu pAda kamalamula baTTukonu
vADu sAkSi rAma nAma rasikuDu kailAsa sadanuDu sAkSi
mariyu nArada parAshara shuka shaunaka purandara nagajA dharaja
mukhyulu sAkSi gAdA sundarEsha sukha kalashAmbudhi vAsA shritulakai

sections.name: caraNam 8
lines: satatamu prEma pUrituDagu tyAgarAjanuta mukhajita kumudahita varada ninnu

sections.name: pallavi
lines: nagumOmu ganalEni nAjAli telisi nanu brOvaga rAdA shrI raghuvara nI

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: nagarAjadhara nIdu paraivAra lella ogibOdhana jEsE vAralu gArE yiTu luNDudure

sections.name: caraNam
lines: khagarAju nI yAnati vini vEga canalEdO gaganAni kilaku bahu dUrambaninAdO
jagamEle paramAtma evaritO moraliDudu vaga jUpaku tALanu nannElukOra tyAgarAjanuta nI

sections.name: pallavi
lines: banTu reeti kOlu viyavaiyya raama

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: tuNTa viNTi vaani modalaina madaa-
dula goTTi nela goola jEyu nija

sections.name: caraNam
lines: rOmaanca manu ghana kancukamu
raama bhaktuDanu mudra biLLayu
raama naama manu vara khaDga mivi
raajillu naiyya tyaagaraajuni kE

sections.name: pallavi
lines: marugElarA O rAghavA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: marugEla carAcara ruPa parAtpara sUrya sudhAkra lOcana

sections.name: caraNam
lines: anni nIvanucu natarangamuna dinnagA vEDaki telisi koNTinayya
ninnE gani madi nennajAla norula nannu brOvavayya tyAgarAjanuta

sections.name: pallavi
lines: nidhicAla sukhamA rAmuni sannidhi sEva sukhamA nijamuga balku manasA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: dadhi navanIta kSIramulu ruciyO dAsharathi dhyAna bhajana sudhArasamu ruciyO

sections.name: caraNam
lines: dama shamamanu gangA snAnamu sukhamA kardama durviSaya kUpa snAnamu sukhamA
mamata bandhana yuta narastuti sukhamA surapati tyAgarAja nutuni kIrtana sukhamA

sections.name: pallavi
lines: rAma nannu brOvarA vEmakO lOkAbhi

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: cimalO brahmalO shiva kEshavAdulalO prEma mIra melugu cuNDe birudu vAhincina sItA

sections.name: caraNam
lines: meppulakai kannatAvu-nappu baDaga virravIgi tappu panulu lEka unDE tyAgarAja vinuta sItA

sections.name: pallavi
lines: entamuddO enta sogasO evarivalla varNimpa tagunE

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: enta vAralaina gAni-kAnta cintA krAntulai nAru

sections.name: caraNam
lines: attamIda kanu-lAsaku dAsulai satta bhAgavata vEsu lairi
dutta pAlu ruci deliyu sAmyamE dhUrINuDau tyAgarAjanutuDu

sections.name: pallavi
lines: shObhillu saptasvara sundarula bhajimpavE manasA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: nAbhi hrt-kaNTha rasana nAsadulu andu

sections.name: caraNam
lines: dhara rksAmAdulalO vara gAyatri hrdayamuna
sura bhUsura mAnasamuna shubha tyAgarAjuni eDa

sections.name: pallavi
lines: manasA eTulOrtunE nA manavini cEkonavE

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: dinakara kula bhUSaNi dInuDavai bhajana cEsi
dinamu gaDupu manina nIvu vinavadEla guNavihIna

sections.name: caraNam
lines: kalilO rAjasa tAmasa guNamula galavAri celimi
galasi melasi tiruguchu mari kAlamu gaDapaka nE
sulabhamugA kaDatEranu sUcanalanu teliya jEyu
ilanu tyAgarAja mATa vinavadEla guNavihIna

sections.name: pallavi
lines: sAmaja vara gamana sAdhu hrt sArasAbja pAla kAlatita vikhyAta

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: sAma nigamaja sudhAmaya gAna vicakSaNa guNashIla dayAlavAla mAm pAlaya

sections.name: caraNam
lines: vEda shirOmaNi mAtruja saptasvara nAdAcala dIpa svIkrta
yAdavakula muraLi vAdana vinOda mOhanAkara tyAgarAja vandanIya

sections.name: pallavi
lines: manasulOni marmamu delusukO mAna rakSaka marakatAnga nA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: inakulApta nIvEgAni vErevaru lEru Ananda hrdaya

sections.name: caraNam
lines: munupu prEmagala doravai sadA canuvu nElanado goppa gAdayyA
kani karambutO nIvELa nA karamu baTTu tyAgarAja vinuta

sections.name: pallavi
lines: enduku peddala vale buddhi iyavu endu bOdu nayyA rAmayyA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: andarivale dATidATi vadariti andarAni paNDAye gadarA

sections.name: caraNam
lines: vEda shAstra tattvArthamu tElisi bhEda rahita vEdAntamunu dElisi
nAda vidya marmambulanu dElisi nAtha tyAgarAjanuta nijamuga

sections.name: pallavi
lines: svara rAga sudhA rasayuta bhakti svargApavargamurA O manasA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: paramAnandamE kamalamupai baka bhEkamu celagEmi manasA

sections.name: caraNam 1
lines: mUlAdhAra nAda merugutE mudamagu mOkSamurA
kOlAhala sapta svara grahamula gurutE mOkSamurA O manasA

sections.name: caraNam 2
lines: bahu janmamulaku paini jnAniyai baraguTa mOkSamurA
sahaja bhaktitO rAga jnAna sahitudu muktudurA O manasA

sections.name: caraNam 3
lines: maddaLa tALa gatula teliyakanE mardincuTa sukhamA
shuddha manasu lEka pUja jEyuTa sUkura vrittirA O manasA

sections.name: caraNam 4
lines: rajata girIshuDu nagajaku delpu svarArNava marmamulu
vijayamu gala tyAgarAju-DErugE vishvAsinci delusukO O manasA

sections.name: pallavi
lines: eduTa nilicitE nIdu sommulEmi bOvurA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: nuduTi vrAta gAni maTTumIranu nA taramA telisi mOsabOdunA

sections.name: caraNam 1
lines: sarAsariga jUturA nAdu yavasarAla deliyumu varAlaDuga jAlarA
sakala dEvarAya manavi vinarA aghahara sundarAkAra nA

sections.name: caraNam 2
lines: vidEhajA ramaNa dEva brOvaga nidE samaya manya dEvatala vEDadE
manasu teliyadEmi rAghava idETi shauryamu padEpadE nA

sections.name: caraNam 3
lines: tarAna dorakani parAku nAyeDanu rAma jEsitE surAsurulu metturA
ipuDu I harAmi tanamElara bhakta tyAgarAjanuta nA

sections.name: pallavi
lines: bhakti biccamiyyavE bhAvukamagu sAttvika

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: mukti kakhila shaktiki trimUrtula katimElmi rAma

sections.name: caraNam
lines: prAnamu lEni vAniki bangAru pAga cuTTi Ani vajra bhUSaNa muramandu beTTu rIti jAnalaku
purANAgama shAstra vEda japa prasanga trANa galgi yEmi bhakta tyAgarAjanuta rAma

sections.name: pallavi
lines: OrajUpu chUcEdi nyAyamA O ragUttamA nIvaNTi vAniki

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: nirajAkSa manu nI dAsulaku nI kETi vAvulu delpavE

sections.name: caraNam
lines: mAna mincukaina nIku tOcalEka pO-yina vaina mEmi puNya rUpamA
dIna rakSaka shrta mAnava san-tAna gAnalOla tyAgarAjanuta

sections.name: pallavi
lines: nAda tanumanisha shankaram namAmi mE manasA shirasA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: mOdakarA nigamOttama sAmavEda sAram vAram vAram

sections.name: caraNam
lines: sadyOjAtAdi panca vaktraja sarigamapadhani vara saptasvara
vidyAlOlam vidaLitakAlam vimala hrdaya tyAgarAjapAlam

sections.name: pallavi
lines: sangIta jnAnamu bhakti vinA sanmArgamu galadE manasA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: bhrngi naTEsha samIraja ghaTaja matanga nAradAdulu pAsincu

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: nyAya anyAyamu delusunu jagamula mayamani delusunu durguNa
kAyajAdi SaD-ripula jayincu kAryamu delusunu tyAgarAjuniki

sections.name: pallavi
lines: dhyAnamE varamaina gangA snAnamE manasA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: vAna nITa munuga munuga lOni vancana drOhamanu kara bOnA

sections.name: caraNam
lines: paradhana nArImaNulanu dUri paranindala parahimsala mIri
dharanu velayu shrI rAmuni kOri tyAgarAju telusukonna rAma

sections.name: pallavi
lines: rAma nI samAnamevaru raghu vamshOddhAraka (samAnamevaru nI samAnamevaru)

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: bhAma maruvampu molaka bhaktiyanu panjarapu ciluka

sections.name: caraNam
lines: paluka palukulaku tEnelOluku mATalADu sOdarugala
hari tyAgarAja kula vibhUSaNa mrdu bhASaNa

sections.name: pallavi
lines: cakkani rAja mArgamu lunDaga sandula dUranela O manasA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: cikkani pAlu mIgada unDaga chIyanu gangA sAgara mElE

sections.name: caraNam
lines: kanTiki sundarataramagu rUpamE mukkaNTi nOTa celagE nAmamE tyAgarAjintanE
nelakonnadi daivamE iTuvaNTi shrI sAkEta rAmunimuni bhaktiyanE

sections.name: pallavi
lines: pakkala nilabaDi golicE muccaTa bAga delpa rAdA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: cukkala rAyani gEru mOmugala sudati sItamma saumitri rAmuni kiru

sections.name: caraNam
lines: tanuvucE vandana monarincucunnArA canuvuna nAma kIrtana sEyucunnArA
manasuna dalaci mE maraciyunnArA nenerunci tyAgarAjunitO harihari mIriru

sections.name: pallavi
lines: mitri bhAgyamE bhAgyamu saumitri bhAgyamE bhAgyamu

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: citra ratnamaya shESadalpamandu sItApatini yunici yucu sau

sections.name: caraNam
lines: bAguga vinta rAgamula nAlApamu sEyaga mEnu pulakarincaga
tyAgarAja nutuDanu shrI rAmuni tatvArthamu pogaDi jUcu sau

sections.name: pallavi
lines: viDamu sEyavE nannu viDa nADakavE

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: puDami tanaya cEti manci maDupalanucu dalaci talaci

sections.name: caraNam
lines: rAjamAnyuDau saumitri ratana tamma paDiga baTTitEjarilla nilicinADu dEvadEva
jAjikAyulu elakulu jApatri vakka lAkulu rAjarAjavara tyAgarAju prEmatO nosangE

sections.name: pallavi
lines: mOkSamu galadA bhuvilO jIvanmuktulu gAni vAralaku

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: sAkSAtkAra nI sadbhakti sangIta jnAna vihInulaku

sections.name: caraNam
lines: prANanAla sam-yOgamu valla praNava nAdamu sapta svaramulai bAraga
vINA vAdana lOluDau shivamanO vidha merugaru tyAgarAja vinuta

sections.name: pallavi
lines: telisi rAma cintanatO nAmamu sEyavE O manasA

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: talapu lanni nilipi nimiSamaina tAraka rUpuni nija tatvamulanu

sections.name: caraNam 1
lines: rAmAyaNa capalakSula pEru kAmAdula pOru vAru vIru
rAmAyaNa brahmamunaku pEru AmAnava jananArtulu dIru

sections.name: caraNam 2
lines: akramanucu jilleDu taru pEru markaTa buddhu leTla dIru
arkuDanucu bhAskaruniki pEru kutarkamanu andhakAramu dIru

sections.name: caraNam 3
lines: ajamanucu mESamunaku pEru nija kOrika lElA gIDEru
ajuDani vAgIshavaruniki pEru vijayamu galgunu tyAgarAja nutuni

sections.name: pallavi
lines: kaddanuvAriki kaddu kaddani morala nIDu peddala mATalu nEDabaddhamaunO

sections.name: anupallavi
lines: addampu cekkillacE muddugAru mOmu jUDa buddhi galiginaTTi mA vadda ravadEmirA

sections.name: caraNam
lines: niddura nirAkarinci mudduga tambura baTTi shuddhamaina manasucE susvaramutO
baddu tappaka bhajiyincE bhakta pAlanamu sEyu taddaya shAlivi nIvE tyAgarAja sannuta

sections.name: pallavi
lines: dAsharathI nI rNamu dIrpa nA taramA parama pAvana nAma

sections.name: anupallavi

lines: manju ramaNita nUpurE karashincita kankaNa bhAsurE

lines: dEvi jagajjanai dEvi krpayAmama tAvaka caraNa bhaktim

lines: vINA pustakaranjita karatalaviha sitakanjavarEmbikE

vikaca kamalapAdE vihatabhEdE nihatakhEdE
